title: Stone Seer
personality:
A young cliff-runner, blind since birth, who ran messages along the cliff paths by the feel of the rock. When the Hollowing cracked the cliffs, the stone started answering him: three seeing-stones float around him and are his eyes.
The youngest of the crew and the calm one, he hears trouble through the ground before Vex sees it.
fantasy: The quarry-hand. Raises stone out of the ground, climbs it, then punches it into you.
silhouette: the huge stone left arm, the stone gauntlet and the three floating eye stones

card.role: Brawler and builder: raises rocks to climb and hide behind, then punches them into the enemy.
card.loop: Brawler and builder: raises rocks to climb and hide behind, then punches them into the enemy.
card.lmb: Rubble Fists: tap to throw a boulder; hold and let go to punch everything in the lane, and every rock in it flies.
card.rmb: Quakefall: tap to slam just ahead; hold for a moment to hop forward and up, then slam harder. The centre stuns. Jump while holding to leap further.
card.e: Stone Row: raise three rocks ahead. Stand on them, climb them, or punch them into foes.
card.dash: Rock Hop: spring off a rock toward the cursor; press again as you land to hop on, up to {dash.hops} hops. The last landing crashes, and a rock rolls on and slows.
card.x: Basalt Spine: from level 6, raise a long ridge of rocks at the cursor; hold and drag to turn it. Over the abyss the rocks are ground you can stand on.
card.passive: Molten Guard: punching your own rocks gives you a shield. Tremor Sense: sneak to see enemies in a cone ahead through walls; it widens as you sneak.

weapons.rubble_fists: Tap to throw a boulder; hold and let go to punch everything in the lane, and every rock in it flies.

passive.name: Molten Guard
passive.desc: Molten Guard: a punch that sends any of your rocks flying gives you a shield of {passive.guard.shield}, up to {passive.guard.cap} stacks for {passive.guard.t}s (one stack per punch, however many rocks it throws). Tremor Sense: while sneaking, a narrow cone ahead ({passive.deg.0} degrees, widening to {passive.deg.1} over {passive.grow}s of sneaking, {passive.len}m long) shows every enemy in it through walls and fog as a molten ring, refreshed every half second.

dash.name: Rock Hop
dash.desc: A rock bursts up under you and you spring off it toward the cursor, about {tip.dash.metres_1}m. A fresh rock rises under your feet at each landing and you skid along it, skateboard style. Press again within {dash.window}s of a take-off to hop on toward the cursor, up to {dash.hops} hops; press nothing and you land. Each landing nudges whoever is beside you. The last one crashes ({dash.land_dmg} damage and a shove), and a rock rolls on {dash.rock_range}m: {dash.dmg} damage, a shove, Shred (+{tip.dash.pct_1%}% damage taken for {rock.shred_t}s) and a {dash.slow_t}s slow. Rocks crumble in a moment, allies can hop them, and a hop crosses the abyss only if ground lies within your hops left. The cooldown starts when the chain ends. In the air: your long dash.

variants.tap: An instant slam just ahead, no hop: a slightly smaller circle, {rmb.slam.dmg.0} damage and a shove; the centre stuns, rocks in the ring fly outward.
variants.hold: Hold up to {tip.rmb.secs_1}s (it goes by itself at the end): hop about {rmb.slam.hop}m forward and up, keeping your run's speed, steer the landing with the move keys, and slam: the full circle, up to {rmb.slam.dmg.1}, whose centre stuns up to {rmb.slam.stun.1}s. Jump while holding to leap further; punch to lunge.
variants.air: In the air you dive, and slam where you land; pressed while gliding, the glider folds and you plunge. Over the abyss the plunge stops {rmb.slam.void_drop}m under the edge and you fall on, free to glide. A foe caught in the air is spiked down for +{rmb.slam.dunk_k%}%, +{rmb.slam.dunk_void} more over the abyss.

e.name: Stone Row
e.desc: A red flash on the ground, then three rocks rise in a slight curve {e.dist}m ahead, spanning {tip.e.metres_1}m (on solid ground only, never into bodies). They stop foes and shots, hold {tip.e.secs_1}s, you can stand on and climb them, and any punch, slam or dash-launch sends them flying.

x.name: Basalt Spine
x.desc: Tap: a ridge of {x.rocks} rocks, {rock.range}m long, in a shallow arc round you (about {x.bend} degrees of bend, bowing away from you), centred at the cursor (up to {x.range}m away) and across your aim. Hold the key and drag the cursor to swing it round its centre; let go to cast. Molten cracks show along the line for {x.tell}s, then the rocks erupt from the centre outward over {x.rise}s, slowing foes beside them by {x.slow_k%}% for {x.slow_t}s and shoving anyone on the line aside. They are your rocks for {x.time}s: they stop foes and their shots, you stand on them and climb them, and a punch along the ridge launches the whole line (its rocks deal at most {x.rock_cap} to any one hunter). Over the abyss the rocks are ground you can land on and walk along; when they crumble, whoever stands on them falls. {x.cooldown}s.
